ambiguities.description: The mentoring ring constraint combines multiple sub-constraints (irreflexive: no self-mentoring; asymmetric: no direct reciprocal mentoring; acyclic: no indirect cycles through chains). The model captures this as a single 'acyclic' ring constraint, but stakeholders may want these formalized as separate constraints (irreflexive + asymmetric + intransitive/acyclic) depending on the modeling tool's support.

source_references.excerpt: Can someone be their own mentor? ... No, never. And you cannot have loops either -- if Alice mentors Bob, then Bob cannot mentor Alice, not even indirectly through a chain.

ambiguities.description: It is unclear whether project assignment is historical (tracking when an employee was assigned/removed from a project) or reflects only current state. The 1-3 project frequency constraint and 'no double assignment' rule suggest a current snapshot, but no temporal/effective-date information was discussed.
